id-second-factor-required: A one-time code is required to continue.
id-account-locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {retry_after} s.
id-role-missing: You do not have access to this platform.
id-otp-invalid: The code is wrong or expired. Attempts left: {attempts_left}.
id-challenge-used: This sign-in request was already handled. Continue where you left off.
id-challenge-invalid: This sign-in request is not valid. Start again from the app.
id-telegram-linked-elsewhere: This Telegram account is already linked to another account. Log out there first.
id-admin-reset-forbidden: Another Administration member has to reset this account.
id-admin-server-forbidden: Only verified clients can connect to the Administration server.
id-password-policy: The password does not meet the requirements.
id-email-taken: This email already belongs to another account.
id-email-locked: The email of an activated account cannot be changed here.
id-otp-no-channel: There is no channel to send a code to. Link Telegram or confirm your email.
id-otp-mandatory: One-time codes cannot be turned off for Administration.
id-self-action-forbidden: You cannot do this to your own account.
id-invalid-status: The account status does not allow this action.
id-activation-invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask Administration for a new one.
id-connector-invalid: The connector settings are not valid.
id-hydra-unavailable: The sign-in service is not responding. Try again later.
id-email-unavailable: The email could not be sent. Try again later.
id-mail-otp-body: Your code: {code}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.
id-mail-otp-ignore: If you did not ask for this code, ignore this email.
id-mail-activation-body: Hello, {name}. An account was prepared for you. Your login: {login}.
id-mail-activation-expires: The link is valid for {hours} hours and works once.
id-mail-notice-email-changed: The recovery email of your account was changed to {new_email}.
id-mail-notice-telegram-linked: Telegram account {telegram} was linked to your account.
id-mail-notice-otp-cancelled: A request to reset one-time codes was cancelled. If it was not you, change your password now.
id-mail-notice-not-you: If this was not you, change your password and log out everywhere.
